content: Zidovudine, marketed under the brand name RETROVIR, is a pyrimidine nucleoside analogue with activity against HIV-1. It is soluble in water at a concentration of 1 mg/mL at 25°C. The molecular formula of zidovudine is C10H13N5O4. RETROVIR Tablets are intended for oral administration. Each film-coated tablet contains 300 mg of zidovudine as the active ingredient. The inactive ingredients in the tablets include hypromellose, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, polyethylene glycol, sodium starch glycolate, and titanium dioxide. RETROVIR Capsules are also designed for oral administration. Each capsule contains 100 mg of zidovudine as the active ingredient. The inactive ingredients in the capsules include corn starch, magnesium stearate, microcrystalline cellulose, and sodium starch glycolate. The empty hard gelatin capsule, which is printed with edible black ink, is composed of black iron oxide, dimethylpolysiloxane, gelatin, pharmaceutical shellac, soya lecithin, and titanium dioxide. RETROVIR Syrup is formulated for oral administration as well. It contains zidovudine along with inactive components such as citric acid, flavors, glycerin, liquid sucrose, and 2% methylparaben (added as a preservative). Sodium hydroxide may be used to adjust the pH of the syrup.
